sources.notes: OpenG2P registry — Odoo modules for individual / group / program registry
G2P Bridge — sits between OpenG2P and Payment Hub EE / Mojaloop
G2P Connect data and API specifications

notes: OpenG2P is Odoo-based (like OpenSPP). REST APIs are exposed via FastAPI modules (`g2p_registry_rest_api`, `g2p_programs_rest_api`) following the G2P Connect specifications. Payment disbursement goes via the G2P Bridge → Payment Hub EE → Mojaloop / banks. No documented native webhook system — integration is primarily pull-based via REST APIs, with Odoo's Automation Rules as an admin-configurable fallback for push (same pattern as OpenSPP).
